en: Last week, someone ran an AI model that normally lives in a data center... on one gaming graphics card.
zh: 上周，有人把一个平时只在数据中心跑的 AI 大模型，塞进了一张游戏显卡里。

en: How? Picture a restaurant kitchen with a hundred and twenty-eight chefs.
zh: 怎么做到的？想象一间后厨，站着一百二十八位厨师。

en: For each word the AI writes, only eight of them cook.
zh: AI 每写一个字，只需要其中八位上手。
